rmsnorm_decomposition.lambda: shared scalar reciprocal-RMS perturbation, outward bounded before candidate execution
rmsnorm_decomposition.residual: componentwise non-radial input propagation plus f32 materialization/rounding

pairwise_bound.derivative_intervals: for each row k, enclose all perturbed logits and derive [min sigmoid', max sigmoid'] on that interval
pairwise_bound.non_radial: sum_m R_m*max_{a in D_i,b in D_j}|a*w_i[m]-b*w_j[m]|
pairwise_bound.fallback: the v1 independent-score sum when any pairwise antecedent is absent

full_set_theorem.selected_set_stable_iff_sufficient: for every oracle-selected i and every oracle-unselected j, oracle_score_i-oracle_score_j > B_pair(i,j)
full_set_theorem.why_rank8_rank9_alone_is_not_general: row-specific perturbation bounds can make a lower-ranked unselected expert the worst challenger
full_set_theorem.internal_selected_order: not required for set identity; if ordered route transport is normative, apply the same theorem to adjacent selected pairs

classification.MATHEMATICALLY_STABLE: minimum pairwise safety factor is strictly greater than 1 under outward rounding
classification.ENGINEERING_HEADROOM: minimum pairwise safety factor is at least 2
classification.headroom_rationale: H=2 reserves one additional complete modeled error envelope for implementation/library drift; it is a candidate policy frozen before retrospective fixture evaluation and requires independent review

guards.outward_rounding: every positive bound accumulation rounds toward +infinity
